purpose: Point-in-time validation of six fixed price/OHLCV alpha mechanisms on the fresh Q043 symbol-disjoint universe before any replication performance computation.

mechanisms.rule: Equal-weight positive sign-vote signals across 21,63,252 sessions.
Top two 252-session returns at fixed 21-session-skip anchor.
Top two cumulative beta-residual returns on fixed 252-session window ending 21 sessions before decision.
Two lowest betas to equal-weight universe on fixed 252-session window ending 21 sessions before decision.
Top two close/trailing-252-session-high ratios at fixed 21-session-skip anchor.
Top two counts of positive overnight return followed by negative daytime return across prior 21 completed sessions.
